    // True when x sits at either end of the unit interval, within the given
    // (non-negative) tolerance. Useful for detecting degenerate curve parameters.
    AlmostZeroOrOne(x: IReal, tolerance: IReal): Boolean
        => x.AlmostZero(tolerance) || x.AlmostEqual(x.One, tolerance);
